name: Temperance
source:
With Casey gone for a few days, Morgan has to take care of their 3-year-old daughter Temperance, who is going through a prolonged temper tantrum phase.

translation:
凱西離開幾天後，摩根必須照顧他們三歲的女兒坦佩蘭絲。她最近動不動就鬧脾氣，已經好一陣子了。
